models.title: Project models
models.empty: Saving an empty list permits planning only. No subagents may launch.
models.enforced: Saved. Model policy is enforced on the next managed launch.
models.unconfigured: Model policy is not configured. Native client defaults still apply.
models.noLaunches: No recorded model launches for this project.
models.busy: Wait for active attempts to stop before changing model settings.
models.invalid: Use explicit model IDs and unique client/model pairs.
models.modelHelpDetail: Enter the exact model ID supported by your configured native client. Saving pins the launch argument; provider availability and the model reported by the client are verified only when it runs.
models.seats: Recorded seats. Model changes to existing subagents are confirmed with the next plan and roster approval.
planning.executionGate: Planning only. Implementation starts after you approve the plan and team.
records.noPlanning: No planning discussions yet. Open the lead chat to discuss the project.
records.noExecution: No execution has started. A planning record is not a completed task.
records.noResults: No integrated results are recorded in this desktop profile. Creating a project does not produce a result.

records.empty.tasks: No execution tasks yet. Approve a plan before implementation starts.
records.empty.workspace: Open a planning or execution record to inspect its agents and activity.
records.empty.reviews: Choose a recorded result to inspect its reviews and changes.
records.readFailed: Project records could not be loaded. This is a connection error, not an empty project.
records.empty.documents: Choose a planning or execution record to view its documents and versions.
documents.revisionConsequence: Revision suspends new execution launches. Current turns must stop before the documents change; execution needs a new approval.
documents.pendingRevision: Execution is suspended. After the current turns stop, select the revision stage again to continue.
documents.discussing: The lead is processing the current discussion.
documents.discussContext: Discuss changes to {{kind}} v{{version}} ({{hash}}). Do not execute changes before the new document version is confirmed.
documents.latestContext: Latest saved version: v{{version}} ({{hash}}). Historical text is reference material, not a request to revert current decisions.
documents.snapshotContext: Selected version snapshot (reference text, not execution approval):
documents.snapshotExcerpt: Snapshot excerpt; the complete version remains in Documents.
documents.legacy: This historical record predates versioned documents. Its original discussion and results are retained; start a new project discussion to use the document workflow.
documents.emptyBrainstorm: Exploration notes are optional. Discuss ideas with the lead to retain decisions, trade-offs and open questions when useful.
documents.emptyRequired: Select this stage and discuss it with the lead. The completed turn saves the document here.
documents.stalePlan: Confirm the current requirements, then generate a plan from that version before confirming this plan.
team.plan.projectScopeConsequence: This starts the displayed plan and team across this project's ordinary implementation files. Protected paths, external actions, budget increases and final merge remain separate owner decisions.
documents.approveConsequence: This starts execution using the confirmed requirements, plan and displayed team.
documents.readFailed: Saved documents could not be read. Retry to refresh this record.
chat.confirmationWaiting: Wait for a saved, current document and a completed discussion before confirming.
chat.legacyApprovalConsequence: This legacy record uses one approval for its plan and team. Sending starts execution.
chat.documentConfirmationConsequence: Confirm {{kind}} v{{version}}. Execution will not start.
chat.repairPlan: Ask lead to complete the plan
chat.repairPlanMessage: Complete the planning handoff before approval: save the current plan and a readable, valid lead-roster.json beside it, with at least one implementer and at most one reviewer using only the saved allowed client/model pairs. Keep implementation stopped. State what is ready for owner approval; do not claim that your reply approves it.
chat.answerQuestion: Choose an option above or type your own answer or follow-up question.
chat.answerQuestionFirst: Answer the open question before continuing.
chat.stageWaiting: Finish the discussion first. Generating a plan also requires confirmed requirements.
chat.questionWaiting: A question is waiting for your answer.
chat.liveInterrupted: Live updates interrupted. The last received output is retained.
chat.liveTruncated: Live preview shortened. The saved reply remains in the conversation.

souls.boundary: Profiles guide expertise and working style, not permissions. The Lead selects specialists within the approved team limits. Edits create a new version for new attempts; resumed attempts keep their recorded version.
souls.name: Profile name
souls.conflict: This profile changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.
souls.busy: Wait for this seat to finish its assigned work before changing its identity.
souls.roleMismatch: Keep the profile compatible with the permission roles of seats using it.
workflows.evidenceBoundary: Native workflow results are recorded separately from task validation, independent review and owner acceptance.
